[[Burned Tower]] }} '''Buzz Off, Butterfree!''' (Japanese: '''VS バタフリー''' ''VS Butterfree''), titled '''Butterfly Butterfree''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 152nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 62nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} This chapter is a flashback to the time when the {{adv|Legendary beasts}} were awakened. A few days after [[Ecruteak City]] was ravaged by an earthquake, its reconstruction is well underway. {{adv|Yellow}} and {{tc|Fisherman}} [[Wilton]] arrive at the city on their {{p|Butterfree}}. Yellow notices that a huge pagoda-like structure is being rebuilt, and decides to have a look. [[Jasmine]], who is supervising its reconstruction, greets the two and thanks them for offering their help. Jasmine informs Wilton that the city's [[Gym Leader]], [[Morty]] was away from the city when the earthquake occurred, but she happened to be there at the time. She thought it would be better for her to stay behind and help reconstruct the city. She refers to the tower currently being reconstructed, as the [[Bell Tower|Tin Tower]], and says that she would have died in there if she hadn't been saved. Wilton notices the absence of any rebuilding work apart from that of the Tin Tower. Jasmine says it's because Morty ordered the reconstruction of Tin Tower before any other building, in order to pacify the furious {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh}}. Jasmine clarifies that Tin Tower is Ho-Oh's sacred domain, and its history dates back 150 years when there were two towers in the city. One of the workers informs Jasmine that a fire is engulfing the other tower. She, Yellow and Wilton quickly follow the worker to the [[Burned Tower]]. Wilton wonders why the two-story structure is referred to as a tower, and Jasmine explains that it is because a previous fire incident burned off the upper floors of the tower. Yellow, thinking that the workers' method of putting out the fire is too slow, flies up with [[Kitty]] above the Burned Tower, and sends out [[Omny]] attached to her fishing rod, which delivers a {{m|Hydro Pump}} to put the fire out. Wilton tells an amazed Jasmine that he taught Yellow how to fish. Yellow quickly notices that she can't pull back her fishing line. She lets out a yelp as she suddenly gets pulled into the Burned Tower. She ends up in a strange room surrounded by three giant ice mirrors. They shatter into pieces without warning, and three quadrupedal creatures appear before Yellow. The one in the middle uses telepathy to speak to Yellow, who remains baffled. Outside, Jasmine and Wilton are still looking for Yellow when they suddenly spot three figures shooting out of the Burned Tower in a flash. Both are still in shock when Yellow finally shows up on Kitty. A while later, Jasmine begins to explain the story of the Burned Tower. When Yellow hears about the three creatures in the story, she realizes that she came across them earlier. ==Major events== * In a flashback, {{adv|Yellow}} lifts {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune}}, {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Entei}}, and {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Raikou}}'s curse and opens the exit to the real world. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Yellow}} (flashback) * [[Jasmine]] (flashback) * [[Wilton]] (flashback) * [[Ecruteak City]] townspeople (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Red}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Omastar}} ([[Omny]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Butterfree}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Chuchu]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Butterfree}} ([[Wilton]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Ampharos}} ([[Amphy]]; [[Jasmine]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Nidoran♀}} (Trainer's; flashback) * {{p|Suicune}} ({{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune|Adventures}}) * {{p|Entei}} ({{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Entei|Adventures}}) * {{p|Raikou}} ({{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Raikou|Adventures}}) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Adventures}}; fantasy) * The {{adv|Legendary beasts}}' previous forms (flashback) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Raikou}} is referred to as {{p|Raichu}}. * In the {{pmin|Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese}} translation, the [[Ecruteak Gym]] is said to be destroyed by the earthquake, instead of [[Ecruteak City]]. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 巴大蝴|VS Butterfree}} |cs=Vs.
